pages.text: Rain stopped and the sun came out. A huge mud puddle formed in front of the yard.
Puddles always made Pipo's feet itch to splash. Today he wanted to splash as much as he liked. He hurried into the yard.
Mr. Horse arrived with a shovel. "Fill puddles quickly! Quick, quick, before it dries!"
He scooped a full shovel of earth and hurried toward the puddle.
At the muddy edge, slide—Mr. Horse slipped.
Splash! He landed on his bottom in the middle. Muddy water shot up like a fountain.
Covered in mud, he blinked. The shovel had flown far away and stuck in the earth.
Pipo jumped in from the edge. Splash!
Splash, splash! Every time Pipo jumped, Mr. Horse burst out laughing.
Mr. Horse sprang up and jumped with him. Splash! Splash! The sound of muddy splashes reached the hill.
